topics.title: Warhammer Tone Pro paints: what they are and how to use them
topics.what_is_driving_it: Games Workshop's Warhammer Tone Pro paint range is launching, backed by a run of Warhammer Community showcases and artist interviews (EavyMetal, Roman Lappat, Angelo Di Chello).
topics.relevance_note: This is the biggest hobby product news of the week, and viewers will want hands-on tests and first-impression painting guides while the range is new.
topics.gap_note: Coverage so far is mostly official articles and interviews. Independent side-by-side tests, first-look painting tutorials and 'is it worth switching' comparisons are largely missing and would be a strong fit for short-form and long-form hobby video.

topics.title: Are Citadel Contrast paints being discontinued, and what replaces them?
topics.what_is_driving_it: Spikey Bits reports that 25 Contrast paint pots are flagged for removal just as Tone Pro arrives, prompting questions about the future of a long-standing hobby staple.
topics.relevance_note: Contrast is one of the most-used paint lines in the hobby, so painters will be looking for clear answers on alternatives and whether their favourite shades are disappearing.
topics.gap_note: The news is being reported as a rumour, with no clear practical guide. A shade-by-shade Contrast-to-Tone Pro comparison or 'what to buy before it's gone' video would answer a live question directly.

topics.title: 40k base size changes: what the new sizes mean for your army
topics.what_is_driving_it: The latest weekly 40k news roundup highlights updated base sizes alongside Legion of the Damned rules changes, raising questions about how existing models will be affected.
topics.relevance_note: Base size changes are a practical concern for every collector and player, and they tend to generate a steady stream of 'does this affect me?' questions.
topics.gap_note: News is circulating as a single line item in roundups. A clear explainer covering which units change, how to rebase models and what it means in games would be useful and under-served.

topics.title: Magnetising Adeptus Custodes with Magnet Baron kits
topics.what_is_driving_it: Magnet Baron has released magnetisation kits covering the Pallas, Telemon, Gyrfalcon and Venatari, letting players swap loadouts on one model for $5.99.
topics.relevance_note: Magnetising is a fast-growing hobby practice, and Custodes is a popular faction with a lot of interchangeable weapon options that suit it.
topics.gap_note: Magnetisation tutorials exist, but step-by-step walkthroughs tied to specific kits and models are sparse. A 'magnetise one Custodes model' build video would serve this audience well.

topics.title: Dark Angels 5-0 at the BCB 40k Championship GT: what the list did right
topics.what_is_driving_it: Benjamin Frederiksen's undefeated Dark Angels list beat Orks and Thousand Sons head-to-head at the BCB 40k Championship GT, with the army lists published.
topics.relevance_note: Tournament-winning lists drive meta discussion and army-building interest, and this one comes right after the new rules and base size updates.

topics.title: How Nurgle spreads plague through the Immaterium
topics.what_is_driving_it: Grimdark Era's Nurgle shorts are getting very high engagement, with 'Seven Signs of Nurgle's Curse' and 'How Nurgle Spreads Plagues' both drawing large audiences.
topics.relevance_note: Nurgle lore is consistently among the most engaged-with Chaos content, and these shorts show viewers want accessible explanations of the Plague God's mechanics.
topics.gap_note: Lore shorts are plentiful, but there are few longer, well-sourced explainers on how Nurgle's Plague Gods, Immaterium and daemonic corruption fit together. A long-form Nurgle lore deep dive would fill this space.

topics.title: Dawn of War IV trailer: Blood Ravens and Dark Angels
topics.what_is_driving_it: The Dawn of War IV trailer featuring the Blood Ravens and Dark Angels is picking up strong views and heavy comment activity across Warhammer's official channel and fan reposts.
topics.relevance_note: A new Warhammer 40K game with a Dark Angels focus is high-interest news, and the comment volume shows viewers are actively discussing it.

topics.title: What happened to the Necromunda RPG?
topics.what_is_driving_it: The Necromunda RPG has disappeared from Games Workshop preview material weeks after its reveal, leaving fans unsure whether it is cancelled or only delayed.
topics.relevance_note: The uncertainty is generating questions from RPG and Necromunda fans, and the story is developing.
topics.gap_note: The story is reported as news without clear explanation or context. A summary of the reveal, the disappearance and what is confirmed versus speculated would answer the questions people are asking.

examples.name: Netflix Documentary

examples.name: Colette

examples.name: Milkshake
examples.cinematic_angle: Slow pan across a Chaos Lord's throne room with the track playing, then a detour to a tiny painted pet or a cute model, and finally the real reveal: the Lord's new paint job, lit by the beat drop.

trend_scout.insight: Lean into hobby-plus-trending-audio, which makes up 46% of this week's sounds and has the highest average score (5.8). Try a Warhammer paint-station timelapse synced to Everything Hallelujah.
